I did not write `notes/arrow-keys.json`, and I can't answer the three questions from what's here.

The declarations in `camera-api.d.ts` are types only. They show the keyboard options (`keys`, `angularSensitivity`, `panningSensitivity`, `zoomingSensitivity`) and nothing about how the library combines keys or handles Alt and Ctrl. The library isn't in `app/node_modules`, and the app has no implementation or notes to fall back on. Any fraction I wrote would be a guess, so I left the file out rather than put made-up numbers in it.

To get the answers, someone needs to run the viewer with the real library (or check its keyboard source), hold the keys for 60 frames, and record `alpha` and `target` before and after each case. I made no changes in `/home/dev/80bf11/app`.
